verdict.rationale: Cake Equity's docs describe core cap table functionality including SAFEs/Convertibles, option grants (NSO/ISO), vesting schedules, contract editor for various instrument types, and migration support positioning it as a single platform of record replacing Carta. However, evidence lacks explicit mention of share classes/certificates management or independent third-party corroboration of it being relied upon by investors/auditors as source of truth. Missing for 10: explicit share class/certificate tracking evidence, third-party/investor-auditor validation, independent case studies confirming live SSOT usage.
